name: @nocobase/plugin-online-count
description: Real-time online user count & management: online list, single-session (device-fingerprint) mutex login, force logout, user blacklist, system broadcast and session logs.
description.zh-CN: 在线人数统计与在线用户管理插件：实时在线人数、在线用户列表、单会话（设备指纹）互斥登录、强制下线、用户黑名单、系统广播与会话日志。
